name: Choumajuu! ~Seieki Juuten Dungeon Kouryaku~
original_name: 超魔汁！～精液充填ダンジョン攻略～
source: The protagonist, who can't use good magic but has magical power, and the two heroines, who can use powerful magic but run out of magical power quickly, are in a magic school story where they bet their graduation. The protagonist can share magical power with others by engaging in sexual activities... so of course, the main activity is sex! They may not be useful in battles against monsters, but the three of them will combine their powers and bodies to overcome various (erotic) difficulties!
translation: 不会使用魔法却拥有魔力的主角，和能够使用强力魔法却很快耗尽魔力的两位女主角，在一个以毕业为赌注的魔法学校故事中。主角可以通过性活动与他人分享魔力……所以，主要活动当然是性！他们也许在与怪物的战斗中没有什么用处，但他们三人将结合他们的力量和身体来克服各种（色情）困难！
